title: Live volume-filtered YM gap rule on a MINI contract, formal scorecard 2015-2023
hypothesis: The YM gap rule with the opening-bar volume filter (>= 1.2x trailing 20-day average) has a gross edge of roughly 10 points per trade. On a micro (MYM, $0.50/pt) the project's $4.50 commission wipes it out; on a mini (YM, $5/pt) cost per trade is about 1.9 points, so the edge may survive. This test puts that on the full 7-check scorecard, including the Deflated Sharpe Ratio.

rules.signal: gap = 08:30 ET bar open minus prior day's last close, in points; trade in gap direction (continuation); only if 08:30 bar volume >= 1.2x trailing 20-day average of 08:30 bar volume
rules.exit: stop, target or 16:00 ET, whichever first (stop checked before target within a bar)

author: claude
disclosure: Not a blind test. results/cost_sensitivity_output.txt (Entry 81) already showed this slice at about net PF 1.36 on mini. The 1.2x threshold was also chosen after seeing 2024+ data. What this test adds is the formal scorecard, a trial-adjusted Deflated Sharpe Ratio, and the sub-period split. It is NOT new out-of-sample evidence; only forward paper data and RTY can be that.

pass_criteria.conditions: net PF >= 1.3 after default costs on 2015-2023, AND net total positive in BOTH 2015-2020 and 2021-2023, AND >= 100 trades
pass_criteria.supported: all conditions met AND scorecard Check 7 (Deflated Sharpe Ratio) passes
pass_criteria.inconclusive: conditions met but the Deflated Sharpe Ratio fails (edge not distinguishable from luck given ~95 trials)
